translated_title: There Are 600 Creditors of TV Azteca; 228 Have Gone at Least a Month Without Being Paid
original_title: Hay 600 acreedores de Tv Azteca; 228 tienen al menos un mes sin cobrar
author: Dora Villanueva
meta_description: A court found Ricardo Salinas Pliego's TV Azteca insolvent, holding just 7.07% of assets against its debts as US bondholders chase a $400 million default.
